hook: MI5 misled 3 separate courts while handling a violent neo-Nazi informant.

sections.voiceover: MI5 misled 3 separate courts while handling a violent neo-Nazi informant.
sections.visual_cue: Close up on a redacted legal document with 3 court stamps visible.
b_roll: Public domain image of a UK courtroom interior

sections.voiceover: The High Court identified that MI5 relied on false evidence on July 2, 2025. The Investigatory Powers Tribunal followed up with a second judgment on July 30, 2025. Did the IPCO, the agency's official watchdog, uncover systemic deception within MI5?
sections.visual_cue: Timeline graphic showing July 2 and July 30 dates.
b_roll: Document scan of court ruling header

sections.voiceover: However, the investigation found one senior MI5 officer lied repeatedly to the courts.
sections.visual_cue: Close up of an official government report folder.
b_roll: Public domain image of IPCO report cover

sections.voiceover: Lord Leveson confirmed MI5 failed to provide candid evidence regarding the violent neo-Nazi, Agent X. Another MI5 officer also misled colleagues and provided false information about his specific instructions.
sections.visual_cue: Portrait of Lord Leveson with an official seal overlay.
b_roll: Public domain photo of Lord Leveson

sections.voiceover: The intelligence agency misled 3 separate courts during this case.
